question.text:
Consider the following page table:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Virtual page} & \text{Frame} \\
\hline
0 & 3 \\
\hline
1 & 10 \\
\hline
2 & 9 \\
\hline
3 & 2 \\
\hline
4 & 0 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

The page size is $1024$ bytes.

Assume that physical address $2075$ belongs to the memory allocated to this process.

What virtual address maps to physical address $2075$?

Enter the answer as an integer.

question.text:
Consider a single-level paging system with:

  • $12$-bit virtual addresses
     
  • $24$-bit physical addresses
     
  • Page size $=256=2^8$ bytes
     

What is the maximum number of entries in the page table of a process?

Enter the answer as an integer.
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
A system uses paging to implement virtual memory and uses a simple linear page table.

The system has:

  • Virtual-address space $=1\text{ GB}=2^{30}$ bytes
     
  • Page size $=1\text{ KB}=2^{10}$ bytes
     
  • Maximum number of physical frames $=2^{15}$
     
  • Each page-table entry contains:
     
    • One valid bit
       
    • The physical frame number
       

Assume that each page-table entry occupies the minimum whole number of bytes.

How many megabytes of memory are occupied by page tables when $100$ processes are running?

Enter the answer in MB.

question.text:
Consider a virtual-memory system that uses paging.

  • $\text{Virtual address length } = 32 \text{ bits}$
     
  • $\text{Physical address length } = 32 \text{ bits}$
     
  • $\text{Page size } = 4\text{ KB} = 2^{12} \text{ bytes}$
     

Process $P_1$ has the following page table:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Virtual page} & \text{Frame number} \\
\hline
0 & \texttt{0x00788} \\
\hline
1 & \texttt{0x00249} \\
\hline
2 & \texttt{0x0023f} \\
\hline
3 & \texttt{0x00ace} \\
\hline
4 & \texttt{0x00bcd} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

What is the physical address corresponding to virtual address $\texttt{0x00001a60}$?

  1. $\texttt{0x00249a60}$
     
  2. $\texttt{0x00788a60}$
     
  3. $\texttt{0x00249001}$
     
  4. $\texttt{0x00001a60}$
